**Chinese name:** 国民技术股份有限公司 (Guómín Jìshù)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The security-silicon incumbent — much of China's compliant TPM/TCM supply for government PCs and banks — and an unexpectedly AI-adjacent one: its April 2026 N32H493 is the first domestic MCU designed for 800G/1.6T optical modules. H1 2026 marked the first half-year profit after years of losses (revenue ¥9.06亿 +43.4%, net ¥4.41m); FY2025 revenue ¥13.60亿 with loss halved.
:::

## What does this firm design?

32-bit general/auto MCUs, secure elements/TPM/TCM, BMS PMICs, optical-module control MCUs, IoT RF.

| **Node Sophistication** | 40nm-class secure MCU/TCM (NS350); mainstream N32 on mature nodes |
